name: auth-failure
description: Wrong credentials. RouterOS answers every REST read with HTTP 401; the 401 branch prints a credential-specific hint (check the username, password, and allowed source address) instead of the generic failure line, and the run ends cleanly with zero assets. request_count pins that 401 is not treated as transient: the first refused menu costs exactly one request.  The task now ENDS IN ERROR rather than reporting a successful run with zero assets: a refused credential and an empty tenant are otherwise the same result, and only the exit status separates them.

log_contains: refused with 401: check the username and password
